answer: The strongest single control I know for this is state diff proof between two epoch roots, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 454 aliases would need 454 separate proofs, each costing about 101 POA or 16 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The vine test is the live device, the ivory test is the locked stake, and the summit test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
